# openstatus_icmp_monitor (Resource)

Manages an ICMP monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_icmp_monitor" "gw" {
  name        = "Gateway Ping"
  uri         = "8.8.8.8"
  periodicity = "1m"
  timeout     = 10000
  active      = true
  regions     = ["fly-iad", "fly-fra"]

  open_telemetry {
    endpoint = "https://otel.example.com/v1/metrics"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `periodicity` (String)
- `uri` (String) Target host or IP address to ping.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `degraded_at` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `open_telemetry` (Block, Optional) OpenTelemetry exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open_telemetry))
- `public` (Boolean)
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions to monitor from.
- `retry` (Number)
- `timeout` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_location_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the private locations that run this monitor. Managed from `openstatus_private_location.monitor_ids`.
- `status` (String)
